description: One Polymarket event (all its outcomes) by event slug, event id, market slug or condition_id: each outcome's price, bid/ask and price history, plus live game state for sports. Prices are YES probabilities 0..1. `interval` is the history's lookback window (1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, 1m, max), not a bar size; keep it short (default 1d) on many-outcome events.

include_no_history.description:
Add binary outcomes' NO-side series (default false). It is always
`1 - p` of `history`, so it only doubles the payload.

key.description: Event slug, Gamma event id, market slug or condition id.
